audit_name: Quality/Sanity Audit of H=12 Held-Out Test Inference Results

item_A_timestamp_integrity.discrepancy: Original inference parsed timestamps without explicit format '%d/%m/%y %H' or dayfirst=True, causing pandas dateutil fallback to guess MM/DD/YY for dates with day <= 12 and DD/MM/YY for day > 12. This produced 6 backwards timestamp jumps (e.g. EP-12: 2017-11-02 to 2017-02-13).
item_A_timestamp_integrity.root_cause: Line 85 of src/detection/dataset_loader.py invoked pd.to_datetime(df['DATETIME']) without explicit format or dayfirst=True.
item_A_timestamp_integrity.corrected_behavior: Parsing with format='%d/%m/%y %H' confirms 2,089 raw rows, 2,066 H=12 windows, strictly monotonic dates from 2017-01-04 00:00 to 2017-04-01 00:00 with zero missing/duplicate timestamps.
item_A_timestamp_integrity.scientific_impact_note: Model forecasting outputs and anomaly scores are mathematically identical; only the calendar label formatting was distorted.

item_B_episode_construction.discrepancy: Original report grouped contiguous anomaly windows using the scrambled default timestamp ordering, artificially splitting contiguous attack blocks across date jump boundaries into 23 pseudo-episodes.
item_B_episode_construction.root_cause: Episode extraction was performed on non-monotonic timestamp strings produced by default date parsing.
item_B_episode_construction.corrected_behavior: Re-extracting contiguous anomalous windows on the strictly monotonic timeline yields 17 true contiguous episodes (e.g. EP-11: 2017-02-08 16:00 to 2017-02-10 20:00 [53h], EP-12: 2017-02-11 14:00 to 2017-02-13 18:00 [53h]).

item_C_numerical_stability.finding: Peak anomaly score of ~1.13e10 (at row 943, 2017-02-12 07:00) is a legitimate physical/model anomaly signal, NOT a numerical bug.
item_C_numerical_stability.investigation_details: Raw data for F_PU3 and S_PU3 contains 0 NaNs, 0 infs, 0 -999 sentinels. During normal baseline training (Dataset03), pump PU3 is OFF (F_PU3 = 0.0), yielding near-zero baseline variance mu_sq[11] = 2.9e-8. When PU3 turns ON in the test set (F_PU3 = 86.49 L/s), dividing squared error (14,294.26) by 2.9e-8 produces Z = 4.87e11.
item_C_numerical_stability.documented_limitation: Dividing by near-zero normal baseline variance amplifies operational state transitions into multi-billion normalized residuals.

item_D_preprocessing_consistency.finding: Inference pipeline uses exact same feature ordering (43 sensors), StandardScaler (fitted strictly on 80% Dataset03 train split), 3-hop graph adjacency, H=12 windowing, and calibration normalization factors as final H=12 training.

item_E_sensor_attribution.finding: Sensor names correspond 1-to-1 with feature columns, residuals are computed correctly, rankings are properly sorted, and topology node mappings match CTOWN.INP graph nodes.

item_F_severity_calculation.finding: Severity formula (Mean * sqrt(Duration) * (1 + Max/tau)) is implemented exactly as documented. Independent recalculation confirms 100% agreement.
item_F_severity_calculation.documented_limitation: Extreme single-sensor residual spikes (~10^11) in EP-11 and EP-12 cause severity scores (~10^19) to numerically dominate the ranking of all other episodes.

item_H_pytest_result.summary: 41 of 41 unit tests passed successfully in 18.37 seconds.
